```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| include: false

if (!requireNamespace("DT2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("缺少 R 包 DT2。请先运行 install.packages('DT2')。")
}

if (!requireNamespace("readr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("缺少 R 包 readr。请先运行 install.packages('readr')。")
}

data_file <- normalizePath(params$data_file, mustWork = TRUE)
extension <- tolower(tools::file_ext(data_file))

read_table_file <- function(path, extension) {
  if (extension == "csv") {
    return(readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE))
  }

  if (extension == "parquet") {
    if (requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)) {
      return(arrow::read_parquet(path))
    }

    duckdb_cli <- Sys.which("duckdb")
    if (!nzchar(duckdb_cli)) {
      stop(
        "读取 Parquet 需要 R 包 arrow 或 DuckDB CLI。",
        "请安装其中之一，或者先把文件导出为 CSV。"
      )
    }

    escaped_path <- gsub("'", "''", normalizePath(path), fixed = TRUE)
    temporary_csv <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
    escaped_output <- gsub("'", "''", temporary_csv, fixed = TRUE)
    copy_sql <- sprintf(
      "COPY (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')) TO '%s' (HEADER, DELIMITER ',');",
      escaped_path,
      escaped_output
    )

    command_output <- system2(
      duckdb_cli,
      args = c("-c", shQuote(copy_sql)),
      stdout = TRUE,
      stderr = TRUE
    )
    command_status <- attr(command_output, "status")

    if (!is.null(command_status) && command_status != 0) {
      stop("DuckDB 转换 Parquet 失败：", paste(command_output, collapse = "\n"))
    }

    return(readr::read_csv(temporary_csv, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE))
  }

  stop("仅支持 .csv 或 .parquet 文件，当前文件是：", basename(path))
}

data <- read_table_file(data_file, extension)

if (nrow(data) == 0) stop("输入文件没有数据行。")
if (ncol(data) == 0) stop("输入文件没有可展示的列。")

names(data) <- trimws(names(data))

if (any(is.na(names(data)) | !nzchar(names(data)))) {
  stop("输入文件存在空白列名。请先为每一列设置唯一列名。")
}

if (anyDuplicated(names(data)) > 0) {
  duplicate_names <- unique(names(data)[duplicated(names(data))])
  stop("输入文件存在重复列名：", paste(duplicate_names, collapse = "、"))
}

source_row_count <- nrow(data)
max_rows <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(params$max_rows))
if (is.na(max_rows) || max_rows < 0) max_rows <- 0L

if (max_rows > 0 && nrow(data) > max_rows) {
  data <- data[seq_len(max_rows), , drop = FALSE]
}

# Convert nested Parquet list columns to readable text.
for (column_name in names(data)) {
  value <- data[[column_name]]
  if (is.list(value) && !inherits(value, c("Date", "POSIXct", "POSIXlt"))) {
    data[[column_name]] <- vapply(
      value,
      function(item) {
        if (length(item) == 0 || is.null(item) || all(is.na(item))) return(NA_character_)
        paste(as.character(item), collapse = " | ")
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }
}

for (column_name in names(data)) {
  if (is.logical(data[[column_name]])) {
    data[[column_name]] <- ifelse(
      is.na(data[[column_name]]),
      NA_character_,
      ifelse(data[[column_name]], "是", "否")
    )
  }
}

source_name <- basename(data_file)
rows_are_truncated <- nrow(data) < source_row_count
```

数据源：`r source_name`。共 `r format(nrow(data), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)` 行、`r ncol(data)` 列。

```{r}
#| label: truncation-warning
#| results: asis

if (rows_are_truncated) {
  cat(
    "> 当前仅载入前 ",
    format(nrow(data), big.mark = ","),
    " 行，源文件共 ",
    format(source_row_count, big.mark = ","),
    " 行。需要全部数据时，将 `max_rows` 设为 0。\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: interactive-table

numeric_columns <- names(data)[vapply(data, is.numeric, logical(1))]
table_options <- list(
  columns = names(data),
  pageLength = 25,
  autoWidth = FALSE,
  paging = TRUE,
  searching = TRUE,
  ordering = TRUE,
  order = list(),
  columnControl = list(
    target = 1,
    content = list("search")
  ),
  layout = list(
    topStart = "pageLength",
    topEnd = list(
      buttons = list(
        list(
          extend = "csv",
          text = "导出 CSV",
          filename = "交互式数据表_筛选结果",
          bom = TRUE,
          exportOptions = list(
            rows = list(search = "applied"),
            columns = ":visible"
          )
        ),
        list(
          extend = "excel",
          text = "导出 Excel",
          filename = "交互式数据表_筛选结果",
          exportOptions = list(
            rows = list(search = "applied"),
            columns = ":visible"
          )
        ),
        list(
          extend = "colvis",
          text = "选择列",
          collectionLayout = "fixed",
          prefixButtons = list("selectAllColumns", "unselectAllColumns"),
          postfixButtons = list("colvisRestore")
        )
      ),
      search = list(placeholder = "搜索全表")
    ),
    bottomStart = "info",
    bottomEnd = "paging"
  )
)

table_options <- DT2::dt2_length_menu(
  table_options,
  values = c(25, 50, 100),
  labels = c("25", "50", "100")
)

table_options <- DT2::dt2_language(
  table_options,
  lang_list = list(
    search = "搜索：",
    searchPlaceholder = "搜索全表",
    lengthMenu = "每页 _MENU_ 行",
    info = "第 _START_–_END_ 行，共 _TOTAL_ 行",
    infoEmpty = "没有数据",
    infoFiltered = "（从 _MAX_ 行中筛选）",
    zeroRecords = "没有匹配记录",
    paginate = list(
      first = "首页",
      previous = "上一页",
      `next` = "下一页",
      last = "末页"
    ),
    columnControl = list(
      search = "筛选本列",
      searchClear = "清除筛选"
    ),
    buttons = list(
      colvis = "选择列",
      colvisRestore = "恢复全部列"
    )
  )
)

if (length(numeric_columns) > 0) {
  numeric_digits <- vapply(
    data[numeric_columns],
    function(value) {
      non_missing <- value[!is.na(value)]
      if (length(non_missing) > 0 && all(abs(non_missing - round(non_missing)) < 1e-9)) 0L else 2L
    },
    integer(1)
  )

  for (decimal_places in unique(numeric_digits)) {
    columns_with_digits <- numeric_columns[numeric_digits == decimal_places]
    table_options <- DT2::dt2_format_number(
      table_options,
      col_specs = match(columns_with_digits, names(data)),
      thousands = ",",
      decimal = ".",
      digits = decimal_places
    )
  }
}

DT2::dt2(
  data,
  theme = DT2::dt2_theme(
    preset = "minimal",
    striped = FALSE,
    hover = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    font_scale = 0.82
  ),
  responsive = FALSE,
  width = "100%",
  extensions = c("Buttons", "ColumnControl"),
  options = table_options
)
```

**操作说明**：拖动表头右边缘调整列宽，内容会随列宽自动换行；右上角“选择列”可逐列勾选，也可在列表顶部全部选择或全部取消；搜索框查询全表；在列名下方输入条件过滤单列；点击列名排序。“导出 CSV”和“导出 Excel”会导出当前筛选后的全部行及当前可见列。所有操作在浏览器内完成。

**汇总说明**：表格底部汇总行按当前搜索和逐列筛选后的全部数据显示。金额及其他数值列显示“合计”，比率列显示非空值的“均值”；分页不会改变汇总范围。
